Chapter 729 - 729 Solved; Ambition!

Chapter 729 - 729 Solved; Ambition!

729 Solved; Ambition!

At this moment, in the void.

The man with the crab head was staring at the screen.

“Protective shield? This planet had such a powerful defense system? Interesting.”

“However, if I block one attack, then I can block two or three high-energy attacks… Or even 100 hits?”

“Tsk tsk, let me test the quality of your defense!”

The man with the crab brain grinned. He twisted the knob at the side and pressed the red button again.

“Whoosh!”

Another dazzling laser beam shot toward Earth.

However, this time, before the laser beam could reach the protective shield, it was blocked by a tall and handsome man.

It was Lin Fan!

He saw…

Lin Fan raised his finger lightly. It was as if there were stars revolving around it, instantly devouring the laser beam.

The crab man and everyone else on the starship widened their eyes in shock.

Then, they all shouted.

“The S-grade high-energy laser cannon was devoured?”

“How is this possible!”

“What kind of monster is that?”

“Isn’t this an ordinary asteroid? Why is there such an existence?”

….

It was no wonder that they were like this.

One had to know…

The S grade high energy laser cannon could already cause damage to universe level warriors.

Generally speaking, even a King class expert would not dare to use his body to take on an S-grade laser cannon.

But what was the situation in front of him?

A young man blocked the S-grade high-energy laser cannon with a single finger.

Who was this young man?

How could an ordinary asteroid have such a powerful existence?

“He must have some special method. There must be a limit to the number of times he can use it!” the crab man said viciously.”

In this world, there were many treasures with powerful defense or powerful attack…

However, most of the things that did not belong to one’s own ability had a limit.

Once the number of times was used up, it would be like waste paper and lose all its abilities.

The crab man pressed the red button again as if to verify his thoughts.

“Whoosh!”

It was the same as before.

Lin Fan raised his hand and absorbed it again.

The crab man did not give up and pressed the red button continuously.

“Xiu! Whoosh! Whoosh!”

Laser beams shot out continuously.

Without exception, they were all blocked by Lin Fan’s finger.

These laser beams couldn’t cause any harm to Lin Fan.

However, the constant attacks also made him a little annoyed.

He saw…

Lin Fan waved his hand in the air.

A huge sword energy immediately appeared behind him.

“Whoosh!”

The sword energy tore through the void, bursting forth with an endless and fierce aura as it flew forward rapidly.

In the eyes of the people on the warship, it was as if they saw a huge and terrifying sword shadow that was as big as the sun, arriving in front of them in an instant.

Even if the warship had powerful automatic dodging and automatic defense capabilities.

However, in front of this Sun Sword Shadow, there was no time to react at all.

“No!”

Everyone’s pupils constricted as they shouted in unison.

“Boom!”

There was a loud bang.

In the void, it was as if a brilliant firework had bloomed.

After the fireworks dissipated, Lin Fan returned to the Coiling Dragon Villa.

Lin Fan smiled,” Let’s continue with the cultivation problem.”

His tone was so relaxed and indifferent.

Who would have thought that he had just taken care of a powerful ocean starship?

Everyone understood that Lin Fan had solved the problem, so they asked even more questions and cultivated even more.

….

Ocean Universe, Second Brigade.

” C102 reporting, Spring Field, coordinates 1289, 321, 564, planet discovered…”

” C102 reporting, Spring Field, coordinates 1289, 321, 456 planet has been successfully occupied…”

….

” C231 reporting. Spring Field, coordinates 2109, 111, 899. Planet found…”

” C231 reporting, Spring Field, coordinates 2109,111,899 planet has been successfully occupied…”

….

One report after another was sent back.

Everyone in the conference room looked satisfied.

They continued to attack with unstoppable momentum!

This was the ocean universe, invincible under the heavens!

As long as he successfully annexed the Four Seasons Universe, the strength of the Ocean Universe would definitely soar.

Everyone seemed to have already seen the invincible power of the ocean universe in the future.

At this moment, another report was sent back.

” C108 reporting, Spring Field, coordinates 5901, 234, 199, planet discovered…”

“Beep! C108 warship signal lost.”

“Beep! C108 warship signal lost.”

Everyone in the meeting room frowned when they heard that.

The universe was vast, and once they got lost, it was a very terrifying thing.

Therefore, all warships would have advanced signal devices to ensure that they could contact the outside world and determine their location at any time.

“What’s with C108?” someone asked. Try to contact him.”

“Beep! The C108 warship has failed to contact.”

“Calling the C108 commander.””

“Beep! Call failed.”

“Calling the deputy commander of the C108 warship.”

“Beep! Call failed.”

….

Everyone tried for a while and finally confirmed that C108 was completely lost.

” Let’s go.” The man sitting in the upper seat muttered,” Send the three warships X201, X301, and X401 to coordinate 5901, 234, and 199 to investigate the situation and capture the planet.””

When everyone heard this, they all revealed a hint of surprise.

Although the disappearance of the C108 warship was probably due to an enemy.

However, wasn’t it a little too much to send three X-series warships to investigate at once?

One had to know…

The 2nd Battalion only had 10 X-series battleships.

Each X grade battleship had the terrifying power to destroy universe level warriors!

” Second Captain,” someone couldn’t help but ask,” could the C108 warship have encountered an unknown disaster?” Wouldn’t it be better to let an X-series warship investigate the situation first?”

The man in the upper position glanced at him and said,”The C108 battleship didn’t even send out a distress signal. Is this something an unknown disaster can do?”

The man opened his mouth, but no words came out.

“Also, don’t you think that the Spring Region is too easy to capture? He did not encounter any powerful force at all.”

“I suspect that the Spring Field has gathered their experts and is ready to launch a surprise attack on our Four Seasons Universe!”

When everyone heard this, their bodies suddenly became solemn and they said in unison,”Second Captain is wise!”

….

Four Seasons Universe, palace.

All the higher-ups gathered.

“The ocean universe’s attacks on the Spring Region are getting more and more violent!”

“The Spring Field has already lost one-third of its territory.”

“Are we really going to give up on the Spring Field like this?”

Their faces were filled with anger.

The first elder wearing a golden mask said,””Giving up is only temporary. We are only concentrating our strength to carry out a better defense!”

“When the universe master returns, we’ll get back everything we’ve lost!”

“Everyone, you must believe in yourself and believe in our Lord!”

In response, many of the higher-ups let out a long sigh.
